question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit between M and J. O sits to the immediate left of J. No one sits to the right of I. Only two people sit between I and O. N sits to the immediate right of L. How many people sit between K and N?
solution: **Given: **Seven people, I, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting in a row, facing north. 1) No one sits to the right of I. 2) Only two people sit between I and O. 3) O sits to the immediate left of J.
